title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1988-03-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Michael Hessberg's Master In-House FM Cassettes; unknown receiver > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience FM capture of a beloved Hampton ’88 night, hailed as the reviewer’s favorite performance.
ai_review.review: The recording was made with Malcolm Kaplan’s microphones routed through a solid FM boom‑box, yielding a clear enough sound that the listener ranks it above the other two nights of the Hampton run. Though no specific songs are highlighted, the reviewer’s enthusiasm (5‑star rating) indicates an overall strong show that has stood out for years.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises the performance and notes a decent FM boom‑box source, suggesting an excellent show with good but non‑professional recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captured via Malcolm Kaplan's mics and a high‑end FM boom‑box with detachable speakers; clear for an audience source, no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer felt this night eventually eclipsed the middle night of the run, indicating a consistently engaging set that holds up as a favorite.
